decls.name: PrincipalGeneratorOfClassEquality

paper_span.quote: every $\varepsilon$ in the same fiber, $A_\varepsilon A_\eta^{-1}$ is principal, so choose $\alpha_\varepsilon\in K^\times$ with $(\alpha_\varepsilon)=A_\varepsilon A_\eta^{-1}$,

decls.rationale: Realizes the paper's choice of \(\alpha_\varepsilon\): two ideals in the same class differ by a principal ideal, so \(A_\varepsilon A_\eta^{-1} = (\alpha_\varepsilon)\) for some \(\alpha_\varepsilon \in K^\times\).
